title: Publish to X
noAccounts: Connect and authorize an X account for this project, then refresh the account list.
planHint: Review the exact content and destination. Preparing a plan does not contact X.
costs: I accept possible X API charges. The cost is not currently known.
eligibility: I understand that API access and Article eligibility depend on this X account and application.
unknownHint: A request may have succeeded. Do not create another plan to repeat it. Check X before resolving this outcome. Automatic retry is disabled.
partialHint: Earlier steps may already be public. Continuing retries only definitively rejected or not yet started steps.
empty: Choose an account and prepare a plan, or select an existing publication.
authorizationRequired: Authorize this account again before publishing.
authorizationChanged: Account authorization or configuration changed. Refresh before continuing.
reviewRequired: Review this content version before preparing publication.
blockedContent: This version has blocking conversion issues. Resolve them before publishing.
mediaRequired: Import every referenced image into this document’s asset library before publishing. Remote images are not fetched automatically.
staleSource: The source changed. Prepare and review a new content version.
draftRequired: Create and confirm the Article draft before preparing public publication.
publicationConfirmationRequired: Confirm the content, account, potential charges and platform eligibility before submitting.
invalidSnapshot: The frozen plan failed integrity verification. Do not retry it.
invalidReceipt: A stored receipt could not be verified. Check the platform outcome.
rateLimited: X rejected the request because of a rate limit. Review completed steps before continuing later.
platformPermissionDenied: X rejected this operation. Check the application permissions and account eligibility.
platformPaymentRequired: X requires payment or API credit for this operation.
platformRejected: X rejected this request. Review the content and account configuration.
platformUnavailable: X did not return a confirmed outcome. Inspect the execution steps before continuing.
invalidPlatformResponse: The platform response could not be verified. The request will not be repeated automatically.
outcomeUnknown: The publication outcome is not yet confirmed. Check X before any further action.
waitingHint: The platform is processing media. Status checks continue automatically, including after a restart. Confirmed operations are not repeated.
mediaLimit: A publication supports up to 64 images. Split the document before preparing a plan.
mediaTooLarge: An image exceeds the X limit of 5 MB. Resize it and review the updated source.
mediaAltTooLong: An image description exceeds 1,000 characters. Shorten it and review the updated source.
mediaReviewRequired: Prepare and review a new content version to confirm image placement.
mediaNotReady: An image is not ready for this publishing account. Inspect its processing status.
mediaExpired: An uploaded image expired. Continuing explicitly will renew images needed by unfinished steps. Confirmed posts will not be repeated.
mediaExpiryUnavailable: X did not report a usable expiry time for the image. Publication is stopped; no expiry is assumed.
mediaProcessingFailed: X could not process the image. Review it before explicitly continuing.
mediaProcessingTimeout: Image processing exceeded the bounded waiting period. Inspect X before continuing.
stopPendingHint: No new steps will be sent. The current request may still finish; its outcome will be recorded.
stoppedHint: The stop request is recorded. Existing posts, drafts and uploaded images were not removed. Unconfirmed requests still need review.
recoveryBusy: This task is still running. Wait for the current request to settle before checking its result.
recoveryChanged: The task changed during verification. Look up the result again before confirming.
recoveryNotMatched: This evidence does not verify a matching Post. The original outcome remains unknown.
recoveryExpired: This lookup has expired. Check the remote result again.
recoveryUnsupported: Read-only recovery is not available for this operation. Its result remains unknown.
recoveryMediaUnavailable: The saved upload receipt has no media key, so its attachment cannot be verified. Nothing will be resent.
recoveryAdopted: Existing Post adopted by the operator; original response was unconfirmed
recoveryUnsupportedHint: This upload, metadata update or Article operation cannot yet be reconciled from a Post lookup. Keep its unknown result for review; do not repeat it.
recoveryHint: If this Post already appears on X, enter its numeric ID. The lookup checks account, content, reply, attachments and time. It will not publish anything.
recoveryCosts: I understand this lookup may incur X API charges.
recoveryMismatch: The Post does not match all checks. Nothing has been resolved or resent.
recoveryUnavailable: The Post could not be verified. This does not mean the original request failed.
recoveryAdoptHint: Matching content is evidence, not proof that PandaForce created it. Adopting this Post records your decision and prevents repeating this step. Remaining steps still need a separate confirmation.
recoveryAccept: I checked this Post and want to use it as the result of this step.
stopAfterCompletionHint: A stop was requested, but the final in-flight operation completed. Its result has been preserved.
supersededHint: This plan is sealed. Its original content and receipts are preserved. Open the continuation to review the remaining work.
continuationHint: Create a new review plan using the same content and X account under its current authorization. Confirmed results are inherited and will not be sent again. Nothing is published until you confirm the new plan.
continuationUnknown: Resolve the unknown request outcome before continuing. A new plan cannot bypass an uncertain publication.
continuationInheritedHint: This plan continues the original reviewed content. Confirmed results are references to the original receipts; only unfinished work can be sent.
planSuperseded: This plan already has a continuation. Refresh and open the new plan.
accountBindingChanged: The connection no longer matches the original project and X account. Its results cannot be inherited.
recoveryAuthorizationChanged: Account authorization changed after the lookup. Inspect the existing Post again before adopting it.
